text: The Company reserves the right to unilaterally cancel, revoke, and claw back all vested and unvested stock options if the Employee is terminated for cause. For the purposes of this agreement, 'cause' shall be defined entirely at the sole, unchallengeable, and absolute discretion of the Board of Directors without any requirement for notice or explanation.

In order to strictly safeguard the proprietary trade secrets and confidential information of the Employer, the Employee covenants and agrees that they shall not, for a continuous period of 12 months following their date of separation, accept any form of employment or engagement with any entity engaged in a similar line of business.

The Employee hereby provides explicit, irrevocable consent to mandatory, unannounced polygraph testing, continuous keylogging, and real-time retina-scan monitoring on personal devices used for work. The Employee explicitly waives any and all rights, protections, or claims under the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023.

Regardless of the Employee's actual location of work, residence, or the jurisdiction where the breach occurred, the Parties irrevocably agree that any disputes, claims, or arbitration arising from this Employment Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the civil courts located in Port Blair, Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

The Employee shall not make any disparaging, critical, or negative remarks about the Company, its officers, or its products on any public forum. A breach of this non-disparagement clause, whether the statements are factually true or not, shall result in the immediate forfeiture of all previously vested equity and unpaid bonuses.
